messages:
fae: seeing repeated 95p latency blips in apac-dedicated-1 this morning. GPUs idle but a subset of hosts show tx_queue blowups and >200ms enqueues.

ryan: any tenant rollout around that time? which hosts/az?

fae: blast from 08:42UTC, hosts rack-12a..12d. trace correlation points to aggressive kvcache prefetch from a single large tenant during warmup. logs show many concurrent short connect/warm requests.

asha: snapshot: tx_queue_depth per-host jumped 18 -> 540, tx_dropped rose, SNAT ephemeral ports climbed but didn't fully exhaust. Pattern looks like simultaneous warmers aligning across allocation-wave.

ryan: that alignment is the problem. we've seen prefill fanout = 64 default in their agent. if many allocs warm at once, egress bursts stack and NIC SCHED drops.

fae: quick ops plan?

asha: immediate: 1) kinetic override to cap tenant prefill_concurrency to 8 for 90m, 2) shift pool egress to alternate SNATs with spare headroom, 3) enable host-level TCP connection reuse for warmers if flag exists.

ryan: apply override for tenant T now and route change to snat-21,snat-22. I'll also drop canary rollout fraction to 5% until we validate.

ops-bot: override applied (id ov-302a): {"tenant":"T","prefill_concurrency":8,"ttl":"1h30m"}.

net-bot: routing update applied for apac-dedicated-1 -> snat-21,snat-22 (id route-302b).

fae: after override + reroute 95p down from 210ms -> 34ms within 3m. good rollback signal.

asha: follow-ups we should track: 1) implement scheduler-side random scatter for prefill waves (spread 4002000ms), 2) add egress-queue-aware feedback: if host tx_queue > threshold, reduce prefill rate for tenants using that host (soft backoff), 3) add per-tenant egress budgeting/alerts so we see noisy fanout before it borders on outage.

ryan: on 2): prototype idea: agents emit prefill tokens with backpressure hints; host agent monitors tx_queue and returns throttle suggestions to orchestrator. minimal infra: ~2 days of infra+agent work.

asha: on 3): infra telemetry change to include ephemeral-port + tx_queue per-tenant aggregates. alert at 60% of snat instance ephemeral capacity or when per-tenant burst rate exceeds X req/s for Y seconds.

fae: cost note: applying overrides + routing is low-cost. adding autoscale/more SNAT capacity would be ~ $0.8/hr per instance. dev work estimate ~ 2-3 dev days across infra and platform.

ryan: who'll take scheduler scatter PR?

asha: I'll open PR with benchmark that simulates 100 concurrent warms and show tail reduction. include config knobs for scatter window and per-host jitter.

ops-bot: incident tag `noisy-warmup-fanout` created for follow-up. escalate if recurrence within 48h.

fae: leaving canary at 5% and watching for 30m. ping here if any regression. :eyes:
file_note: generated slack thread about noisy kvcache prefill alignment, NIC queueing, SNAT routing, and proposed mitigations
